summary: Stellantis N.V. filed a Form 6-K on May 22, 2026, furnishing press releases from its Investor Day 2026 held on May 21, 2026. The filing announces the company's presentation of a new strategic plan, FaSTLAne 2030, a $60 billion five-year plan to accelerate growth and profit, outlined by CEO Antonio Filosa. No specific deal terms, merger consideration, or shareholder vote are disclosed; the event is a routine strategic update for investors, not a binding transaction or special situation requiring classification.
